answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 31937 Country: India Title: Can eight rakat salah (nafil) be offered in one Salam. Question: Can eight rakat salah (nafil) be offered in one Salam. Answer ID: 31937 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 882/882/M=1432) One can do so in nafl salah in nights, but in day time it is makrooh to perform salah of more than four rak’at with one salam: وتکرہ الزیارۃ علی أربع فی نفل النھار وعلی ثمان لیلاً بتسلیمۃ (الدر المختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
